=== FILE: modules/actions/jobparser/testdata/continue_on_error_expr.in.yaml ===
=== METADATA: format=yaml ===
[SUMMARY] name: test jobs: job1: strategy: matrix: experimental: [false, true] runs-on: ubuntu-22.04 continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }} steps: - run: echo hi

name: test
jobs:
  job1:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        experimental: [false, true]
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    steps:
      - run: echo hi
